def drive(me, enemy, arena):
    if me.inverted or me.on_side:
        return None
    
    dist = distance_to(enemy.x, enemy.y)
    bearing = bearing_to(enemy.x, enemy.y)
    
    # Target: Keep the enemy behind the robot to utilize the back spinner.
    # We want the bearing to the enemy to be 180 degrees.
    turn_error = bearing - 180
    while turn_error > 180: turn_error -= 360
    while turn_error < -180: turn_error += 360
    
    turn = turn_error / 60.0
    
    # Speed control:
    # If the enemy is in front (bearing ~ 0), reverse into them to get them behind.
    # If the enemy is behind (bearing ~ 180), push forward to keep them in the spinner.
    if abs(bearing) < 60:
        throttle = -0.6 if dist > 1.0 else -0.4
    elif abs(bearing) > 120:
        throttle = 0.6 if dist > 1.5 else 0.4
    else:
        throttle = 0.3 # Slow movement to align
        
    # Avoid bubble: if near edge, adjust throttle
    dist_center = hypot(me.x, me.y)
    if dist_center > arena.radius * 0.8:
        # If facing the bubble, reverse slightly
        if abs(bearing) > 90: 
            throttle -= 0.3

    # Mix throttle and turn for differential drive
    left = throttle + turn
    right = throttle - turn
    
    return (max(-1, min(1, left)), max(-1, min(1, right)))

def weapons(me, enemy, arena):
    commands = []
    
    # Always keep the back spinner running at max RPM
    commands.append(spin("back", 2000))
    
    # Self-right if upside down or on side (lifter can be used for this)
    if me.inverted or me.on_side:
        commands.append(self_right())
    
    # Use the front lifter if the enemy is close and in front
    dist = distance_to(enemy.x, enemy.y)
    bearing = bearing_to(enemy.x, enemy.y)
    if dist < 1.2 and abs(bearing) < 30:
        commands.append(lift("front"))
    else:
        commands.append(lower("front"))
        
    return commands

def drive(me, enemy, arena):
    if me.inverted or me.on_side:
        return None
    
    dist = distance_to(enemy.x, enemy.y)
    bearing = bearing_to(enemy.x, enemy.y)
    
    # Priority 1: Attack Front (Lifter)
    if abs(bearing) < 60:
        throttle = 0.7 if dist > 0.6 else 0.3
        turn = bearing / 40.0
    # Priority 2: Attack Back (Spinner)
    elif abs(bearing) > 120:
        throttle = -0.7 if dist > 0.6 else -0.3
        # Align the back of the robot with the enemy
        turn = (bearing - 180) / 40.0 if bearing > 0 else (bearing + 180) / 40.0
    # Priority 3: Transition/Align
    else:
        throttle = 0.2
        turn = bearing / 40.0
        
    # Bubble avoidance: push back towards center if facing it near the edge
    d_center = hypot(me.x, me.y)
    if d_center > arena.radius * 0.85:
        b_center = bearing_to(0, 0)
        if abs(b_center) < 45:
            throttle = -0.5

    # Mix throttle and turn for differential drive
    left = throttle + turn
    right = throttle - turn
    
    return (max(-1, min(1, left)), max(-1, min(1, right)))

def drive(me, enemy, arena):
    if me.inverted or me.on_side:
        return None
    
    dist = distance_to(enemy.x, enemy.y)
    bearing = bearing_to(enemy.x, enemy.y)
    
    # Strategy: Avoid head-on collisions with the horizontal spinner.
    # Orbit the enemy when they are in front, and reverse into them with the back spinner.
    
    if abs(bearing) < 45:
        # Enemy is in front. Orbit to the side to avoid the front spinner.
        throttle = 0.4
        # To orbit away: if enemy is left (bearing > 0), turn right.
        # Using turn_cmd logic where turn_cmd > 0 is left turn.
        turn_cmd = -bearing / 40.0
    elif abs(bearing) > 135:
        # Enemy is behind. This is our attack zone!
        # Align the back of the robot with the enemy and reverse.
        target_rel = (bearing - 180) if bearing > 0 else (bearing + 180)
        turn_cmd = target_rel / 40.0
        throttle = -0.8 if dist > 0.8 else -0.4
    else:
        # Enemy is to the side. Move to position them behind us.
        throttle = 0.6
        turn_cmd = bearing / 40.0
        
    # Bubble avoidance: if too close to the edge, push back towards center.
    d_center = hypot(me.x, me.y)
    if d_center > arena.radius * 0.85:
        b_center = bearing_to(0, 0)
        if abs(b_center) < 45:
            throttle = -0.5

    # Combine throttle and turn for differential drive.
    # left = throttle - turn_cmd, right = throttle + turn_cmd
    # If turn_cmd > 0, left < right -> Turn Left.
    # If turn_cmd < 0, left > right -> Turn Right.
    left = throttle - turn_cmd
    right = throttle + turn_cmd
    
    return (max(-1, min(1, left)), max(-1, min(1, right)))

def weapons(me, enemy, arena):
    commands = []
    
    # Always keep the back vertical spinner at max RPM.
    commands.append(spin("back", 2000))
    
    # Recover if flipped or on side.
    if me.inverted or me.on_side:
        commands.append(self_right())
    
    # Use the front lifter to disrupt the enemy if they are close and in front.
    dist = distance_to(enemy.x, enemy.y)
    bearing = bearing_to(enemy.x, enemy.y)
    if dist < 1.2 and abs(bearing) < 60:
        commands.append(lift("front"))
    else:
        commands.append(lower("front"))
        
    return commands
